name: MP2315S
description: 24 V, 3 A synchronous buck in TSOT-23-8 with a selectable power-save (AAM) mode, the core of many 5 V mini modules and a good 12 V-to-5 V part.
notes: Next generation of the MP2315 (which is NRND); same TSOT-23-8 pinout.
AAM pin: resistor divider = power-save at light load, tie to VCC or float = forced CCM.
BST needs a capacitor plus a series resistor (10 Ω in every datasheet circuit).

en.note: Internal 1 MΩ EN-GND: a floating EN = OFF. EN has an internal 5.6 V series Zener clamp: pull up from VIN through a resistor that keeps EN current < 100 µA, RPULLUP >= (VIN - 5.6 V)/100 µA (e.g. 134 k at 19 V); all datasheet circuits µse 499 k VIN->EN. Driving EN directly (no resistor) requires the source to stay below 5.5 V. Rising threshold 1.4 V typ (1.26-1.54), 150 mV hysteresis.

extras.note: Internal 5.1 V LDO bypass: 0.1-0.22 µF, must be no more than 0.22 µF; place right at VCC/GND.
Tied to VCC: forced CCM, lowest ripple. For light-load power save µse the datasheet divider instead: 100 kΩ VCC→AAM, R5 AAM→GND (9.09 kΩ for 5 V, 7.5 kΩ for 3.3 V).

notes: Peak-current-mode, internally compensated, fixed 500 kHz (400-600). Current limit 5.5 A typ (4.5 min / 6.5 max, at 40 % duty); hiccup on UV (FB < 50 % of VREF). OVP at 120 % VREF.

Feedback (T-network): R1 = top (VOUT->tap), R2 = bottom, Rt = tap->FB. R2 = R1/(VOUT/0.791 V - 1). R1 fixed at 40.2 k for >= 1.8 V and 20.5 k for 1.2/1.05 V (Table 1). Table 1 values are based on a 44 µF output cap; other VIN, L or COUT may change R1/R2/Rt.
Feed-forward C5 across R1 in the typical circuits: 33 pF for 5 V and 3.3 V, 22 pF for 2.5/1.8/1.2/1.05 V.

Inductor: 1-10 µH with DC rating >= 25 % above max load; DCR < 20 mOhm for best efficiency; L = VOUT*(VIN-VOUT)/(VIN*dIL*fOSC) with dIL ~ 40 % of the MAXIMUM load current. Use larger L for loads below 100 mA.

BST: a capacitor AND a series resistor are required between BST and SW; all datasheet circuits µse 10 Ω + 0.1 µF (catalog note says ~20 Ω; the datasheet µses 10 Ω). Optional external 1N4148 from VCC to BST for VOUT 5 V/3.3 V or duty > 65 %; then BST cap 0.1-1 µF.
Input: 22 µF X5R/X7R ceramic sufficient for most applications, plus 0.1 µF (C1A) in the typical circuits; RMS rating > half the load current.
Output: ceramic, tantalum or low-ESR electrolytic allowed; typical circuits µse 2x22 µF ceramic.
VIN 4.5-24 V (abs max 26 V); VOUT 0.8 V to VIN*DMAX (DMAX 95 % typ, 90 % min). Fig. 9 (5 V out) is specified from VIN 6.5 V. UVLO 4.05 V rising, 750 mV hysteresis.
Abs max for VCC, AAM, FB, EN: 5.5 V ('all other pins'); EN is protected by its Zener + pull-up resistor.
Layout: CIN and its ground as short/wide as possible; VCC cap closest to VCC/GND; feedback/T-network close to the IC, SW away from FB.
design.pages: MP2315S Rev. 1.0 (12/21/2015); the MPS URL is behind a JS challenge, so the MPS PDF was read via the JLCPCB C3031493 datasheet link. Page-1 typical app (5 V: 4.9 µH, 44 µF, R3 10 Ω, C3 0.1 µF, R1 40.2 k, R2 7.5 k, R6 20 k, R4 100 k, VAAM 0.48 V) p1; abs max (VIN 26 V, all other pins 5.5 V, EN note) p2; EC table (ILIM 5.5 A, fSW 500 kHz, DMAX 95 %, tON min 60 ns, VFB 0.791 V, EN 1.4 V/150 mV, VCC 5.1 V, IAAM 6.7 µA) p3; pin functions (AAM, VCC 0.1-0.22 µF, BST R+C) p7; EN Zener/pull-up, VCC 0.1 µF p9; FB Eq. 1 + Table 1 T-network, inductor 1-10 µH, 40 % ripple, AAM Eq. 4 p11; Fig. 6 AAM, Cin 22 µF, Cout, external BST diode p12; 1N4148 + 0.1-1 µF, layout p13; Figs. 9-11 (5/3.3/2.5 V) p14; Figs. 12-14 (1.8/1.2/1.05 V) p15.
